# SPEC 2.4: with GOEXPERIMENT=simd arm64 lowers array operators and
# reductions to NEON vector forms and never checks an X86 feature. An
# element kind that the lowering keeps scalar (int, uint, uintptr, a defined
# type) gets no vector instruction. Without the experiment, and on riscv64,
# the lowering is unrolled scalar code. The legs read the object code of
# cross builds, so no emulator is needed.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOOS=linux

cd m

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o $WORK/arm64.exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x8$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'FADD V[0-9]+\.S4'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addAlias$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'FADD V[0-9]+\.S4'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addByte$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'VADD V[0-9]+\.B16'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addI32x8$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'VADD V[0-9]+\.S4'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.andF64x2$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'VAND V[0-9]+\.B16'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotF64$' $WORK/arm64.exe
stdout 'FMUL V[0-9]+\.D2'
! stdout 'X86Features'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addInt$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addUint$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addUintptr$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addLane$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumF64$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'

env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -o $WORK/arm64n.exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x8$' $WORK/arm64n.exe
! stdout 'V[0-9]+\.[BHSD][0-9]+'
! stdout 'archsimd'
cp stdout $WORK/arm64n-addF32x8.txt
grep -count=8 'FADDS F[0-9]+, F[0-9]+, F[0-9]+' $WORK/arm64n-addF32x8.txt
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotF64$' $WORK/arm64n.exe
! stdout 'FN?M(ADD|SUB)'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotLane$' $WORK/arm64n.exe
! stdout 'FN?M(ADD|SUB)'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotLane$' $WORK/arm64.exe
! stdout 'FN?M(ADD|SUB)'

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOARCH=riscv64
logos build -o $WORK/riscv64.exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addF32x8$' $WORK/riscv64.exe
! stdout 'archsimd'
cp stdout $WORK/riscv64-addF32x8.txt
grep -count=8 'FADDS F[0-9]+, F[0-9]+, F[0-9]+' $WORK/riscv64-addF32x8.txt
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addInt$' $WORK/riscv64.exe
! stdout 'archsimd'
cp stdout $WORK/riscv64-addInt.txt
grep -count=4 '\tADD X[0-9]+, X[0-9]+, X[0-9]+' $WORK/riscv64-addInt.txt
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotF64$' $WORK/riscv64.exe
! stdout 'FN?M(ADD|SUB)'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotLane$' $WORK/riscv64.exe
! stdout 'FN?M(ADD|SUB)'

env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v3
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -o $WORK/amd64n.exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotF64$' $WORK/amd64n.exe
! stdout 'VFN?M(ADD|SUB)'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotLane$' $WORK/amd64n.exe
! stdout 'VFN?M(ADD|SUB)'
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
logos build -o $WORK/amd64.exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.dotLane$' $WORK/amd64.exe
! stdout 'VFN?M(ADD|SUB)'

env GOARCH=
env GOAMD64=
cd ../q
logos run .
stdout '^ok dot-f64x2$'
stdout '^ok dot-f64x4$'
stdout '^ok dot-f64x8$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x4$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x8$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x16$'
! stdout 'FAIL'
env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o $WORK/dotlaw-arm64.exe .
[!exec:qemu-aarch64] skip 'qemu-aarch64 is required for the arm64 run'
exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/dotlaw-arm64.exe
stdout '^ok dot-f64x2$'
stdout '^ok dot-f64x4$'
stdout '^ok dot-f64x8$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x4$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x8$'
stdout '^ok dot-f32x16$'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arraytargets

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

type f32 = float32

type lane float64

//go:noinline
func addF32x8(a, b [8]float32) [8]float32 { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addAlias(a, b [8]f32) [8]f32 { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addByte(a, b [32]byte) [32]byte { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func andF64x2(a, b [2]float64) [2]float64 { return a & b }

//go:noinline
func addI32x8(a, b [8]int32) [8]int32 { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addInt(a, b [4]int) [4]int { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addUint(a, b [4]uint) [4]uint { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addUintptr(a, b [2]uintptr) [2]uintptr { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func addLane(a, b [4]lane) [4]lane { return a + b }

//go:noinline
func dotF64(a, b [4]float64) float64 { return a.dot(b) }

//go:noinline
func dotLane(a, b [4]lane) lane { return a.dot(b) }

//go:noinline
func sumF64(a [4]float64) float64 { return a.sum() }

func main() {
	var a, b [8]float32
	var c, d [8]f32
	var e, f [32]byte
	var g, h [2]float64
	var i, j [8]int32
	var k, l [4]int
	var m, n [4]uint
	var o, p [2]uintptr
	var q, r [4]lane
	var s, t [4]float64
	println(addF32x8(a, b)[0], addAlias(c, d)[0], addByte(e, f)[0], andF64x2(g, h)[0], addI32x8(i, j)[0])
	println(addInt(k, l)[0], addUint(m, n)[0], addUintptr(o, p)[0], addLane(q, r)[0], dotF64(s, t), sumF64(s), dotLane(q, r))
}

-- q/go.mod --
module example.com/dotlaw

go 1.27

-- q/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
)

type lane float64

type lane32 float32

const trials = 4000

var failed bool

func report(name string, bad int) {
	if bad != 0 {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name, bad, "of", trials)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func dot2() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(2))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [2]float64
		var c, d [2]lane
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane(a[i]), lane(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float64bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float64bits(float64(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f64x2", bad)
}

func dot4() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(4))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [4]float64
		var c, d [4]lane
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane(a[i]), lane(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float64bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float64bits(float64(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f64x4", bad)
}

func dot8() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(8))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [8]float64
		var c, d [8]lane
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float64()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane(a[i]), lane(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float64bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float64bits(float64(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f64x8", bad)
}

func dot4f() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(5))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [4]float32
		var c, d [4]lane32
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane32(a[i]), lane32(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float32bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float32bits(float32(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f32x4", bad)
}

func dot8f() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(9))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [8]float32
		var c, d [8]lane32
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane32(a[i]), lane32(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float32bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float32bits(float32(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f32x8", bad)
}

func dot16f() {
	r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(16))
	bad := 0
	for range trials {
		var a, b [16]float32
		var c, d [16]lane32
		for i := range a {
			a[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			b[i] = r.Float32()*2 - 1
			c[i], d[i] = lane32(a[i]), lane32(b[i])
		}
		if math.Float32bits(a.dot(b)) != math.Float32bits(float32(c.dot(d))) {
			bad++
		}
	}
	report("dot-f32x16", bad)
}

func main() {
	dot2()
	dot4()
	dot8()
	dot4f()
	dot8f()
	dot16f()
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
